study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual-level deviations from normative brain morphology in violence, psychosis, and psychopathy

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Pretrained normative models used Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping (sinarcsinsh).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: normative models were trained using Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping using sinarcsinsh function

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: ROI values of cortical thickness, cortical area, and subcortical volume.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The dependent variable was set to the ROI values of volume, area, or thickness

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and scanner were included as independent variables in the normative models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: the independent variables were age and scanner
